mentions.name: readmepls
mentions.description: This app organizes a personal library of articles saved across multiple browsers and devices, tracks which ones have been read fully or partially, and provides a good reading experience.
mentions.problem: Articles to read get scattered across multiple browsers and devices, and readers forget which ones they have read entirely or partially.
mentions.audience: People who read articles across multiple browsers and devices and lose track of what they have read.
mentions.source_excerpt: For the last couple of weeks, I've been building readmepls (https://readmepls.com) to organize my library, and on top I've been trying to build a good reading experience.
mentions.author: Gisbitus
